ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.30:1; dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) core with high-intensity (white) regions concentrated on the distal margins of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large, contiguous, irregularly shaped high-intensity white region occupies the distal-lateral portion of the left lobe (approx. 10-35% of total width). The right lobe displays smaller, fragmented high-intensity clusters along the superior distal margin (approx. 80-95% of total width).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits 7 primary peaks with amplitudes varying between 10-25 pixels. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits 6 primary peaks, notably more jagged and deeper near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The upper margins follow a convex parabolic curve towards the tips; the lower margins exhibit a concave sweep tapering toward the central peduncle insertion.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular low-intensity clusters (dark spots) are embedded within the high-intensity white patch on the left lobe distal region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Five distinct, high-contrast (white) linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the mid-to-distal region of the right lobe, oriented obliquely.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake mark scarring on the right lobe and significant irregular traumatic serrations along the trailing edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'peppered' pigmentation pattern within the primary white patch on the left lobe, where small dark pixels break the contiguous white surface.
